short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: Volt's bridge circuit has no resistors in series and none in parallel. He's stuck.
The trick: turn the triangle into a Y. Same three terminals, same behaviour, and suddenly series and parallel work again.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: Product of the two touching, divided by the sum. The bridge becomes easy.
